description: Up to eight knobs for the extended macros of an overlay preset, each one configured by hand for a macro number, a name, a range and a control mode; it works with a CHEM Overlay
notes: a new module is blank and has no controls at all until it is configured: put it beside its CHEM Overlay, then press F2 or choose Edit from the right-click menu to open the editing panel
in the editing panel, click a knob number to work on that slot, then give it a name, a macro number from 7 to 90, a range and a control mode; Load preset macros fills the macro menu
the three control modes are Knob only, a knob with no jack; CV-modulated, a knob with a jack and a modulation amount; and CV-driven, a jack with a moving track in place of a knob
the knobs and jacks are built when the module is configured, so none of them can be clicked for help here; the maker's own tooltip on each carries the name you gave it
control voltage into these jacks is read as bipolar, -5V to 5V, so an LFO feeding one should have its offset turned off
to control more than eight extended macros, add another one of these
MIDI to the instrument stops while the editing panel is open
menu: Edit — opens and closes the editing panel to the right, and is greyed out until the module has found an Overlay
Center knobs — sets every configured macro knob to the middle of its range
